milestone_brief:
# ingest-robustness-m1 — section-less chunker fallback + shipped MinerU PDF Stage-1 CLI + standing MinerU wiring + ar5iv structure gate

## Context
Two 2026-Q2 Bridgeland-stability target papers exposed gaps in the ingest lane.

- **hep-th/0002037** (Douglas–Fiol–Römelsberger, "Stability and BPS branes", 2000) fails ingest with `chunker_returned_empty` on 6 consecutive runs. Its ar5iv/LaTeXML render at `var/arxmcp/corpus/parsed/hep-th/0002037/index.html` (also cached at `var/arxmcp/cache/ar5iv/hep-th/0002037.html`) is COMPLETE — 50 KB text, 93 `ltx_para`, 115 `ltx_p`, 321 `<math>` — but has ZERO `ltx_section`/`ltx_theorem` containers (title renders "Untitled Document"): LaTeXML failed the sectioning/title pass on the 2000-era format. Both chunker passes in `ingest/chunker.py` find nothing — `_extract_chunks_from_container` (~:554, keyed on `ltx_theorem_*`/`ltx_proof`) and `_extract_section_chunks` (:740/:768, keyed on `_SECTION_DIV_CLASSES` at :154, where `ltx_para` is NOT `ltx_paragraph`). So `all_chunks=[]` at chunker.py:901 and `ingest/bulk_ingest.py:305` classifies `chunker_returned_empty`, discarding 50 KB of real content. This silently drops ANY section-less render that passes the ar5iv `<math>` gate.

- **2602.24016** (Pertusi overview) is PDF-only (no usable ar5iv/arxiv.org HTML: ar5iv render is math-less, arxiv.org/html 404). It was ingested via MinerU into the `bridgeland-stability-pdfs` notebook using GITIGNORED ad-hoc drivers (`var/phase2_textbook_driver.py`, `var/parse_pdfs.py`). There is NO shipped CLI for the MinerU Stage-1 (MinerU parse + LaTeXML render); operators rely on throwaway `var/` scripts. MinerU v3.2.3 IS installed at `C:/Users/cedar/venvs/mineru/Scripts/mineru.exe` but is unwired: `ARXMCP_MINERU_BIN` is unset and mineru is not on PATH, so `ingest/textbook_parser.py:_resolve_mineru_binary` (:181) cannot find it.

## Acceptance criteria
1. **Chunker section-less fallback.** When a parsed render has body content under `ltx_document` (`ltx_para`/`ltx_p`) but yields zero chunks from BOTH existing passes (no `ltx_section`-family, no `ltx_theorem_*`/`ltx_proof`), emit prose chunks from the top-level content blocks. Same content-addressable, deterministic `chunk_id` scheme (preamble+body sha), token-capped to `STMT_MAX_TOKENS`, deduped by the existing rule. `chunk_paper('hep-th/0002037')` on the on-disk HTML MUST yield >=1 chunk. MUST NOT change chunk output for any already-working sectioned paper (regression-guard against a fixtured sectioned paper).
2. **Shipped MinerU Stage-1 CLI.** A supported `tools/` CLI (e.g. `tools/notebook_pdf_parse.py <slug> --paper-id <id>`) that runs `run_mineru_sandboxed` + `render_mineru_to_html` to produce `parsed/<flat>/index.html` for a textbook-kind notebook, replacing the gitignored `var/` drivers. Unit-tested with a MOCKED mineru binary (no real 30-min GPU run in tests). Idempotent (skip if index.html exists).
3. **Standing ARXMCP_MINERU_BIN wiring.** Make MinerU discoverable without a per-shell export: persist the binary path via the `operator_settings` store (mirror the contact-email pattern in `tools/_notebook_common.py:resolve_contact_email` + `server/operator_settings.py`) and/or a documented `make init MINERU_BIN=...`; `_resolve_mineru_binary` consults it (precedence: explicit arg > ARXMCP_MINERU_BIN env > operator_settings > shutil.which > raise). Document in `docs/install.md`.
4. **ar5iv structure gate.** After an ar5iv render passes the `<math>` presence check but is structurally unchunkable, emit a DISTINCT, categorized signal (not a silent generic `chunker_returned_empty`) so operators can route to the PDF path. At minimum bulk_ingest distinguishes "render structurally unchunkable / no_sections" from a generic empty, and the ar5iv fetch logs a `no_sections` warning. (Once the fallback in AC1 lands, hep-th/0002037 is no longer unchunkable — the gate is for the residual truly-empty case.)
5. **Tests + gate.** Tests cover each AC; `ruff check .` clean; the repo's pytest gate green ACCOUNTING FOR the ~29 pre-existing Windows-platform failures documented in CLAUDE.md §3/§8 — the milestone must ADD no new failures (establish the baseline first).

## Out of scope (operational; done AFTER code lands, against the live `var/` corpus in the main tree)
- Re-ingesting hep-th/0002037 (chunker fallback recovers it from on-disk HTML; plus a MinerU PDF backup copy).
- The 2602.24016 SQLite bookkeeping backfill (notebook_papers junction row + `tools/notebook_metadata_backfill.py`).

## Affected files (starting points)
`ingest/chunker.py`, `ingest/bulk_ingest.py`, `ingest/ar5iv_fetch.py`, `ingest/textbook_parser.py`, new `tools/*.py` CLI, `server/operator_settings.py`, `tools/_notebook_common.py`, `docs/install.md`, `docs/usage.md`, `tests/`.
